text: Just as an image does not remain in a mirror without a living being, or as a shadow does not exist without a standing object or a nail, or as coldness does not exist without water, or as water does not exist without coldness, or as fire does not exist without heat, or as wind does not exist without touch, or as space does not exist without void, or as earth does not exist without smell, so too, by this analogy, the Tattvas (elements) do not remain without the specific and non-specific Tanmatras (subtle elements).
